resources.string: Consent first, then a finite app and SafeNest Test control guard. Stop test remains available.

After your separate consent, SafeNest Test checks foreground app package IDs and narrow Settings or installer labels on this phone. During an active 60-minute test it returns Home from selected blocked apps and recognized SafeNest Test disconnect, Forget VPN, Uninstall or Force stop screens, sometimes as soon as the screen opens. Observations are not recorded or uploaded. It does not read browser pages, messages or passwords. Stop test ends the guard. Accessibility permission controls and unrelated apps remain available. This is not Device Owner permission.
